## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `id` | `string` | The coupon set's id (`launch-codes`). |
| `name` | `string` | The coupon set's name. |

| `total_count` | `integer` | Number of codes in the set. |

| `archived_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the set was archived (ISO-8601 UTC), or null. |
| `metadata` | `object` | Key-value pairs you attach to the coupon set. |
